D.name: Indoor Cabin Sauna
D.intro: A classic red cedar sauna room for your basement, spare room or condo, in seven sizes from a cozy 4' × 6' for two to a 6' × 8' for six. Solid single-stave Grade A western red cedar, a glass door and a flat roof that fits most rooms, made in Canada.
specs: A reasonably level concrete or tile floor; not over hardwood or engineered flooring
Grade A western red cedar, knotty or clear; solid single-stave bevels with no tenon joints
Glass sauna door, 5 mm single-pane glass
Open cedar benches; two-tier layout on selected sizes
Flat style roof for easy installation in most rooms
240V, 30–50 amp depending on the heater; final hookup by a licensed electrician
Windows, roof overhang or flat top, L-bench, back-wall or side benches, and more, planned with you in a consultation
6 kW electric, sized for this room

groups.title: Choose your heater package
groups.note: Sized for 4' × 6' to 5' × 7' rooms: 6 kW. For 6' × 7' and 6' × 8' we’ll size the heater up in your quote. Every package is ready to fire: the heater, its control and the right fill of stones. Electric heaters need a dedicated 240V circuit installed by a licensed electrician. Indoor saunas use electric heat only.

about.title: A traditional sauna, sized to your room
about.lede: Pick the size that fits your space; every one is built the same way, from solid Canadian red cedar.
items: From 4' × 6' for a condo or small basement up to 6' × 8' for six. All are 82⅛" tall, so they fit under a standard basement ceiling.
Grade A western red cedar in seamless single-stave bevels with no tenon joints, for a clean finish that lasts.
Comfortable open benches, with a two-tier layout on selected sizes, and a glass door that keeps the room bright.
Add windows, choose a roof overhang or a clean flat top, and pick an L-bench, back-wall or side benches. We plan these changes with you in a free consultation and include them in your quote.
